title: “Nice Knives”
deck: A still life for a short film, distributed by BAM In Motion.
lede: “Nice Knives” is a short film directed by Connor Copeland and distributed by BAM In Motion. Its poster is a still life: a ham on a cutting board with bread, cheese and butter, a knife standing upright, under the title in bright yellow.
challenge: “Nice Knives,” a short film directed by Connor Copeland in New York City and distributed by BAM In Motion, needed a poster.
work: The poster is a still life: a ham on a cutting board, with sliced bread, cheese, butter and a glass of eggs, and a knife standing upright. The title runs above it in tall yellow letters.
system: A ham, bread, cheese and a knife.
